newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firms with futures, premiums steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firms with futures, premiums steady.

text.p: NWE gas oil rose on ebullient benchmark IPE futures on Tuesday, with premiums steady amid fairly good trade.
On the cargo market, there was talk low sulphur traded into Le Havre at Oct IPE +$17, but this was not confirmed.
German heating oil was also firm with a fair amount of demand into Hamburg.

Many traders said immediate concerns about the effects of some 400,000 tonnes of north American gas oil due to arrive in Europe over the next two weeks were subsiding on talk that many of the cargoes have been placed.
"A lot of the cargoes appear to be destined for the buyers' systems for reblending which will soften the impact of the extra supply," one traders said.
Traders noted, however, one or two transatlantic cargoes were being touted around on the market.

On the barge market, prompt premiums remained high with deals reported at Oct IPE +$9.25 fob ARA. First half October premiums also appeared to be creeping up with deals heard at Oct IPE +$6.25 fob ARA in the morning and premiums of +Oct IPE +$6.75/+$7 seen in the afternoon.
